symptoms: Pod stays Pending with forbidden: exceeded quota events
Create rejected by admission for CPU, memory, pods, or PVC count
diagnosis: oc describe quota -n <namespace>
oc describe pod <pod> -n <namespace> — read FailedCreate or quota message
oc get resourcequota -n <namespace> -o yaml
remediation: Reduce resource requests or replica count in manifest
Raise ResourceQuota limits with change approval
Delete unused workloads consuming quota
verification: Pod schedules and reaches Running
quota used <= hard limits

symptoms: Pod rejected at admission: maximum/minimum resource violation
Container limits below namespace LimitRange minimum
diagnosis: oc get limitrange -n <namespace> -o yaml
oc describe pod <pod> — admission error details
remediation: Adjust requests/limits to satisfy LimitRange min/max/default
git_patch deployment resources
verification: Pod admitted and Running

symptoms: Pod events ErrImageNeverPull — image not present locally with imagePullPolicy Never
diagnosis: oc describe pod — confirm imagePullPolicy: Never
Check if image exists on node: crictl/cursor debug node
remediation: Pre-load image on node or change pull policy to IfNotPresent/Always
Use correct tag available on node
verification: Container starts without image pull errors

symptoms: Container killed after failed postStart lifecycle hook
diagnosis: oc logs <pod> -c <container>
oc describe pod — postStart hook command and exit status
remediation: Fix hook script or increase hook timeout
Remove hook if non-essential; use initContainer instead
verification: Pod Running; hook completes successfully

symptoms: Job status Failed; pods BackoffLimitExceeded
diagnosis: oc describe job <job> -n <namespace>
oc logs job/<job> or failed pod logs
remediation: Fix application error causing non-zero exit
Adjust backoffLimit/activeDeadlineSeconds if transient
verification: Job completes with succeeded >= 1

symptoms: CronJob exists but no recent Jobs created
suspend: true or invalid schedule
diagnosis: oc get cronjob <name> -o yaml — schedule, suspend, lastScheduleTime
Check controller-manager logs if cluster-wide
remediation: Fix cron schedule syntax; set suspend: false
Resolve Forbid/Replace concurrency blocking
verification: New Job created at expected schedule

symptoms: PVC phase Lost; PV unavailable or deleted
diagnosis: oc get pv,pvc -n <namespace>
Check storage backend and reclaim policy
remediation: Restore from snapshot if available
Recreate PV/PVC pair with backup data — requires approval
verification: PVC Bound; workload mounts data

symptoms: Pod Pending — volume node affinity does not match selected node
diagnosis: oc describe pvc and pv — nodeAffinity terms
Compare pod scheduled node vs PV zone/region
remediation: Schedule pod in matching zone or use regional storage class
Recreate PVC in correct zone
verification: Pod scheduled on node matching PV affinity

symptoms: Pod sandbox creation failed — CNI plugin not initialized
Node NotReady with network unavailable
diagnosis: oc get pods -n openshift-multus or kube-system — CNI pods
Check node conditions NetworkUnavailable
remediation: Restart CNI/daemonset pods on affected node
Verify CNI config on node (/etc/cni/net.d)
verification: New pods get IP addresses; node Ready
openshift_notes: Check openshift-sdn or OVN-Kubernetes operator health

symptoms: Service has no ready endpoints; traffic blackholed
diagnosis: oc get endpointslice -n <namespace> -l kubernetes.io/service-name=<svc>
Verify pod labels match service selector and pods are Ready
remediation: Fix selector or pod labels; fix failing readiness probes
verification: EndpointSlice lists ready pod IPs

symptoms: API error: rejected by webhook
Deploy/patch fails with admission webhook denial
diagnosis: Read webhook denial message in kubectl/oc output
Check validating/mutating webhook configuration and webhook pod logs
remediation: Fix manifest to satisfy webhook policy (OPA, Kyverno, cert-manager, etc.)
Temporarily bypass only with break-glass approval
verification: Apply succeeds; webhook logs show allow

symptoms: ImageStream tag import failed; deployment cannot resolve internal image
Build/deploy references ImageStreamTag not imported
diagnosis: oc describe imagestream/<name> -n <namespace>
oc import-image or check external registry credentials
remediation: Fix source registry pull secret on builder SA
Re-import tag or point deployment to external image directly
verification: ImageStreamTag shows imported metadata; pods pull successfully

symptoms: HPA reports FailedGetResourceMetric or scaling limited
Replicas stuck at min/max
diagnosis: oc describe hpa <name> -n <namespace>
Verify metrics-server or custom metrics adapter
Check resource requests on target deployment
remediation: Install/fix metrics-server; add CPU/memory requests to target pods
Adjust minReplicas/maxReplicas or metric target
verification: HPA shows valid metric and scales under load test

symptoms: Pod fails mounting ConfigMap subPath or duplicate keys
Hot-reload not reflected in container
diagnosis: oc describe pod — mount propagation and subPath
Verify ConfigMap keys exist
remediation: Fix subPath/key references; restart pod after ConfigMap update if not mounted as volume
verification: Pod Running; application reads expected config

symptoms: Pod killed after terminationGracePeriodSeconds
SIGKILL after preStop hook timeout
diagnosis: oc describe pod — termination grace and preStop
Check application shutdown handling in logs
remediation: Implement graceful shutdown; increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds if justified
Fix preStop hook duration
verification: Rollouts complete without forced SIGKILL in normal conditions

symptoms: Node DiskPressure=True; pods evicted
EmptyDir or logs filling node disk
diagnosis: oc describe node <node> — conditions and allocated ephemeral storage
Check /var/lib/kubelet or container runtime disk usage
remediation: Prune unused images/containers; expand node disk
Reduce ephemeral-storage limits or log volume
verification: DiskPressure cleared; new pods schedule on node

symptoms: Pod terminated due to preemption by higher priority pod
Unexpected restarts on congested nodes
diagnosis: oc describe pod — preemption events
Review PriorityClass on workloads
remediation: Assign appropriate priorityClassName to critical apps
Add capacity to reduce preemption
verification: Critical pods stable under load

symptoms: Deployment creates new ReplicaSet but pods not selected
selector immutable field error on patch
diagnosis: oc get rs -n <namespace> — show-labels
Compare deployment selector vs pod template labels
remediation: Fix template metadata.labels to match spec.selector
Recreate deployment if selector must change (requires migration)
verification: ReplicaSet owns expected pods; rollout completes

symptoms: StatefulSet stuck — pod-N not Ready so pod-N+1 not created
Update blocked on partition or ordinals
diagnosis: oc get pods -l app=<sts> — ordinals and Ready column
oc describe statefulset — currentRevision vs updateRevision
remediation: Fix lowest ordinal pod first (storage, probes, config)
Use partition rollback if bad rollout
verification: All ordinals Ready; currentRevision matches desired

symptoms: Internal error: webhook timeout
Creates fail intermittently under load
diagnosis: Check webhook service endpoints and latency
Review failurePolicy and timeoutSeconds in webhook config
remediation: Scale webhook backend; increase timeout with care
Fix slow policy evaluation
verification: Admission latency stable; creates succeed
